question: John wants to start a zoo.  He has 15 snakes.  He has twice as many monkeys as he does snakes.  He has 5 fewer lions than he does monkeys.   John has 8 more pandas than he does lions.  John has 1/3 as many dogs as he does pandas.  How many total animals does John have?
completion:

He has 5 fewer lions than monkeys, so he has 30 - 5 = 25 lions.
He has 8 more pandas than lions, so he has 25 + 8 = 33 pandas.
He has 1/3 as many dogs as pandas, so he has 33 / 3 = 11 dogs.
Therefore, John has a total of 15 snakes + 30 monkeys + 25 lions + 33 pandas + 11 dogs = 104 animals.
FINAL: 104

question: Arnold owns three cars. The first car averages 50 miles per gallon of gas. The second car averages 10 miles per gallon of gas. And the third car averages 15 miles per gallon of gas.
